title: An Act to Make Allocations from Maine Turnpike Authority Funds for the Maine Turnpike Authority for the Calendar Year Ending December 31, 2027

summary.text: This bill makes allocations from gross revenues of the Maine Turnpike Authority for the payment of the authority's operating expenses for the calendar year ending December 31, 2027 in accordance with the requirements of the Maine Revised Statutes, Title 23, section 1961, subsection 6.
